MIDFIELD_CONTROL.name: Midfield control
MIDFIELD_CONTROL.objective: Win the centre of the pitch and keep the ball.
MIDFIELD_CONTROL.favorable: Central midfielders with strong mentality and attack.
MIDFIELD_CONTROL.advantages: Midfield improves with the quality of your midfielders.
MIDFIELD_CONTROL.risks: Slower progression (less attack). Loses force against compact blocks and high pressing.

WIDE_PLAY.name: Wide play
WIDE_PLAY.objective: Stretch the opponent and attack the flanks.
WIDE_PLAY.favorable: Wingers and attacking full-backs against weaker opposing full-backs.
WIDE_PLAY.advantages: Attack improves with your wingers; deep blocks concede the flanks.
WIDE_PLAY.risks: Fewer players centrally and advanced full-backs.

COUNTER_ATTACK.name: Counter-attack
COUNTER_ATTACK.objective: Absorb pressure and attack the space the opponent leaves.
COUNTER_ATTACK.favorable: Fast forwards against teams that leave space.
COUNTER_ATTACK.advantages: Attack improves with your forwards and the opponent's space; solid central defence.
COUNTER_ATTACK.risks: You cede the midfield. Barely works against teams that leave no space.

HIGH_PRESS.name: High press
HIGH_PRESS.objective: Win the ball high up the pitch.
HIGH_PRESS.favorable: Physically strong midfielders and forwards against teams that build slowly.
HIGH_PRESS.advantages: Midfield and attack improve with physique; weaker against a secure build-up.
HIGH_PRESS.risks: Leaves space behind the defence; the effect fades for low-stamina squads.

LOW_BLOCK.name: Low block
LOW_BLOCK.objective: Protect the middle zones and concede territory.
LOW_BLOCK.favorable: Solid centre-backs, defensive midfielder and goalkeeper.
LOW_BLOCK.advantages: Defence improves with your centre-backs; leaves no space behind.
LOW_BLOCK.risks: Less attack and midfield. Weaker against teams attacking wide.
